name: Hoarding
description:
You feel an irresistible urge to gather a hoard of gold, jewels and other finery. When you spread your hoard out in an enclosed, private space and sleep atop it, you gain special restorative benefits.

At the end of each long rest (or each night of Intermezzo) where you sleep atop your hoard, add together the total Treasure you have with you, plus the cost, in Treasure, of all the equipment items you have with you. For every 20 Treasure of value, choose one (choose each option only once):

  • Uncheck a Condition.

  • Regain BODY Endurance.

  • Remove 1 Injury.

  • Gain 1 Hope.

While atop your hoard in an enclosed private space, all your rolls are favored. If a creature threatens your hoard, all your rolls against it are favored while it remains within sight of your hoard.

Describe your relationship with gold and other riches.
